applicabilityBasis.summary: spUSDC is the USDC-denominated Spark Savings V2 ERC-4626 share. Its redemption exchange rate accrues the governance-set savings yield, and Spark documents its economic backing through USDS in the Spark Liquidity Layer. The share has no documented fixed monetary-value issuer redemption obligation.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-07. spUSDC is the current Spark Savings V2 ERC-4626 yield-accruing share, distinct from legacy sUSDC V1 and the separate Morpho sparkUSDC strategy vault. The share is denominated/redeemed in USDC through available liquidity, while Spark documentation describes V2 economic backing entirely in USDS through the Spark Liquidity Layer. Yield changes assets redeemable per share, so the share has no documented fixed monetary-value issuer redemption obligation under GENIUS section 2(22). Payment-stablecoin authorization, issuer pathway, foreign exception and DASP payment-stablecoin restriction remain not-applicable; no parent USDC permission is inherited.
